issues.description: Method SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal): the problem statement's UML explicitly declares orderMeal as returning void (problem_statement.md, UML line shows +orderMeal(Meal): void) and the textual task describes its behavior as a procedure that enqueues an order and calls checkOrderReady(). However, the solution implementation declares the method as public boolean orderMeal(Meal meal) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java (signature at line 12). This mismatch between the specified void return type and the solution's boolean return type can confuse students about the expected signature and whether they should return a success flag from orderMeal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent with the specification. Preferably change the solution implementation to match the problem statement: update src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java to declare public void orderMeal(Meal meal) (remove the boolean return type) and remove any return true/false statements. Alternatively, if the boolean return is desired, update the problem statement/UML to document and require a boolean return and explain its semantics.
